{{ety|pl|:inh|zlw-opl:chodzić|:af<surf>|chód|-ić|tree=+|text=+}}

===Pronunciation===
{{pl-pr|a=Pl-#.ogg;LL-Q809 (pol)-Olaf-#.wav|mp=#|prz=#|PM=#|MD=#|EL=#|WL=#|kuj=#|MB=#|kie=#|las=#|krk=#|suw=#|nbl=#|zag=#}}

{{pl-verb|impf-indet|freq=chadzać|det=iść|pf=pójść}}

# {{lb|pl|intransitive}} to [[walk]] {{gl|to move by means of one's feet}}

#: {{syn|pl|[[wspinać]] [[się]]}}

#: {{uxi|pl|'''Chodzę''' na siłownię dwa razy w tygodniu.|I '''go''' to the gym twice a week.}}
# {{lb|pl|intransitive}} to [[go]] in; to [[wear]] {{gl|to go in a particular vestment}} {{+obj|pl|:w(loc)<what>}}

#: {{syn|pl|[[spotykać]] [[się]]}}
# {{lb|pl|intransitive|copulative}} to [[go]] {{gl|to continuously or habitually be in a state}}
# {{lb|pl|intransitive|colloquial|of vehicles}} to [[go]] {{gl|to follow a particular route}}
#: {{syn|pl|kursować}}
# {{lb|pl|intransitive|colloquial|of devices}} to [[work]] {{+obj|pl|:na(loc)<on a source of power>}}
#: {{syn|pl|działać}}
#: {{uxi|pl|Mój laptop '''chodzi''' na baterii najwyżej trzy godziny.|My laptop '''works''' on battery for at most three hours.}}
#: {{uxi|pl|Ten zegarek dawno przestał '''chodzić'''.|This clock stopped '''ticking''' a long time ago.}}
# {{lb|pl|intransitive|colloquial|of body parts}} to [[bob]], to [[throb]], to [[tremble]] {{gl|to move beyond one's volition}} {{+obj|pl|dat<whom>}}
# {{lb|pl|intransitive|of shudders}} to be [[feel|felt]] on the body

## {{lb|pl|intransitive|impersonal|Western Kraków|Smardzowice}} to [[spread]] {{gl|to be published}} {{+obj|pl|:w(loc)<in what publication>}}
# {{lb|pl|intransitive|colloquial}} to [[get]] [[stuck]] in one's  [[head]] {{gl|to remain constantly in one's thoughts and memories}} {{+obj|pl|:za(ins)<whom>}}
#: {{syn|pl|[[przyczepić]] [[się]]}}
# {{lb|pl|intransitive|colloquial}} to be an [[object]] of [[desire]] for someone
# {{lb|pl|intransitive|proscribed}} to [[go for]] {{gl|to visit a particular location to finish a particular task or to acquire a particular thing}} {{+obj|pl|:za(ins)<what>}}

#: {{syn|pl|dbać|[[troszczyć]] [[się]]}}
# {{lb|pl|intransitive|impersonal}} to [[mean]], to [[be on about]]; to [[have in mind]] {{+obj|pl|dat<who, i.e. the subject of the English sentence> + :o(acc)<(about) who or what/what in mind>}}
#: {{syn|pl|iść|[[rozchodzić]] [[się]]}}

====Conjugation====
{{pl-conj-ai-ić|cho|dz}}
* In the {{w|Masovian Borderland dialect}}, the second person imperative singular may be formed as {{m|pl|chodzi}}.
* In the {{w|Far Masovian dialect}} ({{w|Przasnysz}}), the second person imperative singular may be formed as {{m|pl|chodzij}}.
* In the {{w|Eastern Lublin dialect}} ({{w|Tomaszów Lubelski County}}) and the {{w|Masovian Borderland dialect}} ({{w|Radom}}) , the second person imperative singular may be formed as {{m|pl|chodz}}.
* In the {{w|Eastern Lublin dialect}} and the {{w|Western Lublin dialect}} ({{w|Lublin Voivodeship}}) , the second person imperative singular may be formed as {{m|pl|chódź}}.
* In the {{w|Western Lublin dialect}} ({{w|Gmina Serniki}}), the second person imperative dual may be formed as {{m|pl|chojca}}.
